papers.title: A biomimetic hierarchical structure on selective laser melting titanium with enhanced hydrophilic/hydrophobic surface
papers.first_author_affiliation: Center for Precision Engineering, Guangzhou Institutes of Advanced Technology Chinese Academy of Sciences, Guangzhou 511458, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xuetong Sun
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Precision Engineering, Guangzhou Institutes of Advanced Technology Chinese Academy of Sciences, Guangzhou 511458, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM钛合金表面润湿性改性，但与应力屏蔽、刚度匹配或疲劳无关。
llm.why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding, no mechanical testing, no fatigue evaluation, and no osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 在SLM钛上构建仿生分级表面以增强润湿性。
summary_zh.method: 选择性激光熔覆结合表面处理制备微纳结构。
summary_zh.result: 实现了亲水/疏水性能的显著增强。
summary_zh.validation: 通过接触角测量验证表面润湿性。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate a biomimetic hierarchical surface on selective laser melted titanium for improved wettability.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting followed by surface treatment to create micro/nano structures.
summary_en.result: Significantly enhanced hydrophilic and hydrophobic properties were achieved.
summary_en.validation: Surface wettability was validated by contact angle measurements.
